qualification: Six authored60ms VP9/stereo PCM fixtures include exact finite integer/float controls, truncated byte/channel tails and IEEE NaN/Infinity. Native3-frame video controls pass for every case. Before all four malformed companions return successful decoded packets.

Playback now validates complete frames and finite samples before returning any packet; output allocation is fallible and no intermediate f32 vector is added. Existing owned strict conversion behavior stays unchanged.

Real AudioPlayback capture checks valid controls through replay/navigation and verifies refusal before any backend PCM for malformed packets. These are refusal tests, distinct from successful finite playback acceptance.
Legacy unit expectation that a partial PCM frame is silently dropped is replaced with an explicit incomplete-frame refusal. Valid PCM results/signatures unchanged.
No speed or physical-device claim; ordinary tests run offline from saved authored fixtures.
compatibility: Malformed incomplete/non-finite playback PCM now returns an error instead of truncation/non-finite output. Callers relying on implicit tail dropping must repair or explicitly frame their input; no public method signatures change.
counting: One strict playback PCM-admission improvement, aligning the existing owned contract. Structural/numeric bad-packet variants, allocation checks and tests add no IDs.
